title.narrative: Support to ZHRC

description.narrative: The specific objective of the proposed Action is the strengthened capacity of the Zimbabwean Human Rights Commission to carry out its mandate to promote and protect human rights in Zimbabwe, particularly through access to national documentation, a human rights based electoral process and good governance in the conduct of state affairs. outcomes: 1.Increased access to national documentation among communities experiencing challenges, through the implementation by relevant stakeholders of ZHRC National Inquiry recommendations 2.Government agencies increasingly comply with human rights obligations related to the electoral process, including through improved redress mechanisms for electoral-related human rights and administrative justice violations 3.Strengthened Public Protector function of the Zimbabwe Human Rights Commission

comment.narrative: ZHRC also innovatively managed to carry out an outreach activity on the sidelines of a Zion ChristianChurch National Annual Gathering Conference held in Gokwe. This was a novel way of engaging theChristian community which ZHRC intends to replicate in future programming given the irnportant roleof the church in national developrnent processes. The outreach activity at Zion Christian Church AnnualConference is estimated to have addressed a gathering of approxirnately 30000 participants who attendedthe annual conference. Because of the sheer numbers of the people who graced the occasion it wasdifficult to maintain a register of the people and ZHRC relied on the statistics provided by the church.
